children: Director David B. Gendell reported purchasing 4,000 shares of IES Holdings common stock through his IRA on November 24, 2026, in two transactions at a weighted average price of $163.25 per share, for a total purchase amount of $653,000. Following the transactions, Gendell directly owned 141,721 shares and indirectly owned 96,000 shares: 16,000 through his IRA and 80,000 through a family trust.
